trimmingSuggestions.description: The Host doesn't start cooking outside until 1:33. The first minute and a half of the video could be shortened or removed to make the video more dynamic.
In the final scene, the Host talks in a rambling manner which makes the scene feel slow. Removing some of this rambling would also make the video more dynamic.
The three cuts in Scene 2 (01:16 - 01:17, 02:12 - 02:13, and 02:29 - 02:30) should be removed as they are distracting.
